remarks: Please submit offers by 9 AM Tuesday, June 30- thank you for showing   Welcome to this charming and beautifully maintained 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home nestled in Stamford's highly desirable Springdale neighborhood. Offering the perfect blend of comfort, character, and convenience, this inviting residence features a spacious finished basement, abundant attic storage, and thoughtfully designed living spaces throughout. Step outside to your own private retreat, where a stunning backyard showcases gorgeous gardens and plenty of space for entertaining, relaxing, or enjoying the outdoors. Situated on a quiet residential street, this home provides the peaceful neighborhood setting buyers are looking for while remaining just minutes from shopping, dining, parks, schools, and major highways for an easy commute. Whether you're hosting family gatherings, enjoying a quiet evening in the garden, or taking advantage of all that Springdale has to offer, this exceptional property is ready to welcome you home.
